slides.title: Which one is wrong?
options: The transformer design was introduced in 2017 in the paper 'Attention Is All You Need'.
Retrieval-augmented generation requires retraining the whole model on your documents.
Prompt injection is listed by OWASP among the main security risks for applications built on language models.

slides.title: B is wrong
slides.body: RAG looks documents up when you ask, so it does not need the model to be retrained.

slides.title: Check the confident ones
slides.body: Wrong statements often sound as sure as right ones. Check a source.
